waypoints.name: Trabzon

waypoints.name: Sultan Murat Plateau
waypoints.advice: Sultan Murat Plateau comes up 49 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Uzungol, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Trabzon → Sultan Murat Plateau climbs about 2200 m in 61 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Sultan Murat Plateau → Uzungol drops about 2200 m over 20 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Uzungol → Rize is 61 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Trabzon → Sultan Murat Plateau
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 63 km. 2200 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Turkey D915 Derebasi Bends
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2200 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

turkey-black-sea-mountain-road.story: A 147 km one-way ride from near Trabzon, about 2 h 24 of riding. The stops in between: Sultan Murat Plateau and Uzungol. The highest point is about 2,200 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
